value: The five hierarchy ranks used by the Weisberg, McCoy & Krot (2006) meteorite classification, in descending order: division (highest; children of the root, Meteorites), class, clan, group, subgroup. Ordered by skos:notation and linked by xkos:next / xkos:previous; referenced by the classification levels via xkos:organizedBy.
